newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC STORMS INTO SECOND ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC STORMS INTO SECOND ROUND.

text.p: Third seed Goran Ivanisevic stormed into the second round at the Australian Open with an easy 6-2 7-5 6-3 win over Australian Ben Ellwood on Tuesday.
The Croat, who is seeking to win his first grand slam tournament, kept his occasionally volatile temperament in check to demolish the inexperienced qualifier.
Ivanisevic, a losing finalist at Wimbledon in 1992 and 1994, will play the winner of the match between Dutchman Paul Haarhuis and Karol Kucera of Slovakia in the second round.
